title: Red panda
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='30' r='14' fill='#c94a1a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='30' r='14' fill='#c94a1a'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='30' r='8' fill='#f4a460'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='30' r='8' fill='#f4a460'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='27' fill='#e8602a'/>
  <!-- White face patches -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#ffe4cc'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='46' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#ffe4cc'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='46' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#ffe4cc'/>
  <!-- Forehead stripe -->
  <path d='M44 28 Q50 40 56 28' stroke='#b33a10' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a14'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a14'/>
  <circle cx='37.5' cy='46.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65.5' cy='46.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3b1f12'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 62 Q50 66 54 62' stroke='#8b4513' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f7a090' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f7a090' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#c94a1a'/>
  <!-- Chest white -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#ffe4cc'/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='93' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3b1f12'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='93' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3b1f12'/>
  <!-- Tail hint -->
  <path d='M72 90 Q82 82 80 70' stroke='#b33a10' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 78 Q78 74 80 70' stroke='#ffe4cc' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
